user.title: Connect to Irrigation Caddy
user.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of your Irrigation Caddy controller.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Irrigation Caddy. Check the host/IP and that the device is online.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Irrigation Caddy is already configured.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Choose which of the controller's outputs appear in Home Assistant. A zone that is not selected gets no Run Now switch, no duration slider and no field in the program editors — use this to hide outputs that nothing is wired to. Saving a changed selection reloads the integration.

run_now.title: Run Now
run_now.description:
How long each zone waters when you switch it on from the Run Now device. The default is used by any zone that has not been given a time of its own. Capped at {max_run} minutes.

Zones — {zones}

program_1.title: Program 1
program_1.description:
Edit program {program} on the controller. Leave a start time blank to clear that slot; set a zone to 0 to skip it. Zone run times are capped at {max_run} minutes. Only the zones selected under Zones are shown — the rest keep whatever the controller already has.

Zones — {zones}

error.save_failed: The controller rejected the schedule. Check that it is reachable and try again.
error.no_zones_selected: Select at least one zone — hiding every zone would leave nothing to run.

abort.no_device_data: No schedule data has been read from the controller yet. Wait for it to come online and try again.

set_program.name: Set program schedule
set_program.description: Create or update a watering program's schedule on the Irrigation Caddy. Any field that is omitted keeps its current value on the device.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the program is allowed to run on its schedule.

days.name: Days to run
days.description: Days of the week the program should water. Omit to keep current days.

start_times.name: Start times
start_times.description: Up to 5 start times in 24-hour HH:MM format, e.g. "06:00", "18:30". Omit to keep current start times.

zone_durations.name: Zone durations
zone_durations.description: Map of zone number to run duration in minutes, e.g. zone 1 = 10, zone 3 = 15. Zones not listed are set to 0 (skipped). Omit to keep current durations.
